svg.desc: FTTI per safety goal: SG-01 FTTI 500 ms to 707 ms; SG-02 FTTI 500 ms to 707 ms; SG-03 is met by a limit; SG-04 FTTI 447 ms to 775 ms; SG-05 FTTI 516 ms to 894 ms; SG-06 FTTI 500 ms to 707 ms (as SG-02); SG-07 FTTI 447 ms to 775 ms (as SG-04); SG-08 FTTI 357 ms to 357 ms; SG-09 is met by a limit.
svg.text: How long each safety goal lets a fault last
WP-S-04 §2, Figure 2-2: how far a fault moves the vehicle over time, for the largest (solid) and smallest (dashed) fault, the margin it must not
reach, and the FTTI where it does, split into detect, react and reserve. Computed from proposed margins and fault ranges; nothing is measured.
